section_path: Other and Ill-Defined Respiratory Sites and Intrathoracic Organs
text:
C390  Upper respiratory tract, NOS
C398  Overlapping lesion of respiratory system and intrathoracic organs
C399  Ill-defined sites within respiratory system

**Note:** TNM is not defined for this schema. If directly assigning Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000), use the *Other & Ill-Defined Respiratory Site &  Intrathoracic Organs* chapter on page 164 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=164).
